notes: Reviewed the full dispatcher-like body and both available callers. The body validates a record flag, dispatches according to selector and record bits to several helpers, and returns or tail-calls into related routines; callers at 32804 and 32836 use the result in attribute-record processing but do not identify the operation narrowly. The proposal correctly leaves the semantic name blank.

Reviewed the complete body and available callers. It obtains status key 0x4a, compares the result against a record value, validates several context/object conditions and pointer slots, and sets a computed object byte. Direct callers do exist at main_0082.c:30089 and :30402 and main_0079.c:2396, contrary to the proposal note that none were found; those call contexts still do not establish the identifier or mutation meaning. Keeping the name blank is appropriate.

Reviewed the full vector computation and available callers. The body branches on selector ranges and special values, reads selector-indexed table data and context values, then constructs floating-point vectors via helper calls. Callers at main_0158.c:16405 and main_0014.c:33379 use its vector results in subsequent calculations, but do not identify the exact output semantics. The blank semantic name is justified.

Confirmed the proposed predicate name against the full body and callers. The routine reads context status key 0x13, resolves the status/context objects, validates status/type fields including +0xc0 and +0xc8, and on a particular mode consults the indexed query_diamond_dynasty_context_status helper. Callers use it as a context/status test, including the caller that screens a value through 0xd9 before using the result. This supports the broad name; the exact underlying status meaning remains unknown.
